selections.comment: A competitive affair, with handicap debutant TROPICAL RETREAT the suggestion. The subject of good market support when fourth on debut at Dundalk before Christmas, she since made the breakthrough when dropped to the minimum trip at the all-weather venue. Starting on turf now, she could prove nicely treated off an initial mark of 72. Top-weight Likedbymike returns to calmer waters after finishing last over the course and distance earlier this month. Hampered with over a furlong to go in that Listed heat, she was given an easy time of it thereafter. Beauty Queen was seventh in that same contest and it'll be interesting to see how she fares in first-time cheekpieces. The 88-rated Jorge Alvares, Tipperary winner Bobbi Rosa and the Denis Hogan-trained Sarahmae are others to note.

Starting off for rookie trainer Maurice Ahern, it'll be interesting to see how seven-time winner Art Of Unity fares.

She was below par in a Listed race at the end of the season, but if she can hit the ground running on her return, she should be able to play a part. Castro Aurum is of definite interest returned to a handicap, and Ciara Pearl can show better than she has done on her first two starts this year. However, it looks like they might come up short against MANARA, who has been steadily progressive and drops in class today.

It is DESERT SHADOW, though, who can come out on top here. He has been progressive so far and can come on again.

selections.comment: An open race where some of the least exposed appeal most. THE LAST DROP wasn't given a hard time on her recent handicap debut where she hinted that this longer trip could deliver more. That was her first run in nearly a year and if making the expected improvement she could be tough to stop. Point winner Matchadam ran well for a long way before being outstayed over 3m on his handicap debut here. If fit after a break he could prove the biggest danger back down in trip ahead of Dartmouth Rose who conceded first run on her recent handicap debut and will enjoy this track more.
